body.name: Version-stability and topological bottleneck audit handle
body.construction: For each adaptive measured endpoint pair, first compare all \(C^1\) representatives in \(\mathfrak F_{A,B}(P_X)\) by local support geometry and Whitney-extension uniqueness to determine membership in \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\). For a separator \(Z\), then start from the regular-conditional factorization of a representative through the published \(|Z|\)-dimensional sufficient map. If an \(r\times r\) minor is nonzero, restrict to an \(r\)-dimensional affine slice on which the inverse-function theorem makes a coordinate projection locally injective; because the conditional mean is constant on sufficient-map fibers, use invariance of dimension to rule out \(r>|Z|\), while auditing almost-everywhere versions.
